name: Wells State Park
evidence: RA official site map: 008 (25 ft) and 018 (24 ft) sit between shore road and Walker Pond, which DCR calls a pond. Leaf-off satellite 42.1389,-72.0620: spur pad ~10-15 m from water; 42.14298,-72.06128: pad ~25 m. Other loops are farther. No road or day use between. USGS 1 m DEM: pads ~1-2 m and ~4-5 m above the 177.4 m pond, no steep climb.

name: Historic Valley Campground
evidence: City site map: 4,5,7,9,11,13-15 on the ring nearest Windsor Lake; city sells Lakeside sites. Leaf-off satellite 42.6853,-73.0908: pads ~30-40 m from shore through woods, none within 25 m; headland is the campers' beach and pavilion. No official photo of a view, so held at not waterfront.

name: Lake Dennison Recreation Area
evidence: RA official site map: North sites 110-114 (25-38 ft) on the peninsula's west shore, not tagged Near Water. Satellite 42.64686,-72.08811: legible tan pad under open pines ~10 m from waterline with a small sand landing; second pad ~22 m in frame ld_n.

name: Myles Standish State Forest
evidence: RA official site map: Barretts J020, J023 (RV/trailer, 25 ft) on Barretts Pond's north shore, DCR-named pond. Satellite 41.8466,-70.6930: open tan clearing running to the water, ~8 m, and a site ~22 m back. Pin is ~130 m east of this loop. Fearing shore undecided under canopy; not needed.

name: Nickerson State Park
evidence: Satellite 41.7690,-70.0258: pads ~20 m from Flax Pond but RA types all Area 5 sites POPUP/TENT, so no motorhome. Area 1 and west-shore pads ~65-85 m (nk_n, nk_w); Area 6/7 loops 100 m+ from Little Cliff (nk_s2). RA official photos show no site view; ponds earn no view value.

name: Tolland State Forest
evidence: RA official map: shore sites 025-031, 033-036 are tent/pop-up or under 23 ft; 024, 032, 023 (24-30 ft) sit inland. Leaf-off satellite 42.1478,-73.0413 and 42.1510,-73.0435: road and pads ~55-70 m back behind a tree belt. RA official photo tsf07 shows gravel site with reservoir through trees, site number unknown.

name: Travelers Woods of New England
evidence: Operator site map (travelerswoods.com, 2022): sites 43-61 back onto Falls River with nothing mapped between. Satellite 42.6611,-72.5428: tables and an RV outside the outer loop, ~11-20 m from channel through a thin leaf-off bank fringe; no road between. Operator also runs W/E RV sites here. Operator: all 125 sites sold daily, weekly or longer.
